title: just let me do it
description: A Copper Golem based mod powered by OpenRouter AI that can build and interact with your world. Inspired by Purplers video.
body:
🤖 Just Let Me Do It: The AI-Powered Copper Golem! 🧱
Just Let Me Do It is a revolutionary Fabric mod that brings the fan-favorite Copper Golem to life with a "brain" powered by OpenRouter AI. No longer just a button-pusher, this golem can understand your commands, build structures, and interact with the world in ways never before possible in Minecraft. ⚡

Heavily inspired by Purpler’s AI Golem video, this mod bridges the gap between Large Language Models and blocky reality. ✨

🌟 Key Features ⚙️
🧠 LLM-Integrated AI: Powered by the OpenRouter API, the Copper Golem can process complex instructions and decide how to execute them in-game.

🏗️ Autonomous Building: Ask your Golem to build a house, a bridge, or a tower. Watch as it calculates the placement and constructs it block-by-block.

💎 The Golem Core: Craft a unique Copper Golem Core to bring your mechanical friend to life. A high-tier recipe for a high-tier companion!

💬 Interactive Dialog: Open a custom UI to chat with your Golem, give it tasks, or check its status.

🛠️ Fully Configurable: Easily swap between different AI models (like GPT-4o or Claude 3) by changing the settings in your config file.

🧪 Crafting the Core 🛠️
To create your Golem, you'll need to craft the Copper Golem Core using the following materials:

Materials:

D = Diamond 💎

C = Copper Ingot 🧡

N = Nether Star 🌟

Crafting Table Pattern:
| | | |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| D | C | D |
| C | N | C |
| D | C | D |

⚙️ Setup & Configuration 📂
To use this mod, you will need an OpenRouter API Key.

Launch the mod once to generate the config file. 🚀

Navigate to .minecraft/config/just_let_me_do_it.json.

Paste your API key into the apiKey field. 🔑

(Optional) Change the model field to your preferred AI model.

📦 Requirements 📌
Fabric Loader 🛠️

Fabric API ⛓️

Active Internet Connection 🌐 (Required for AI communication)
